description: Find NCI biomarker concepts by name or synonym. The public tier returns codes, name, type, trial count, synonyms, parent_ids, ancestor_ids and eligibility_criterion. These concepts differ from diagnostic --biomarker filters and literal trial --variant text. Use search trial --source nci --biomarker-code CODE for trials that list an exact concept. Native criteria do not establish patient eligibility.
